purpose: Reduce the hd_exec-compatible option-surface gap by accepting all author variant names for directed HDResult value output while explicitly refusing author variant algorithm or performance equivalence claims.

implemented_change.before: The parser accepted eb/nn/itk/clover/rt choices but run_rtdl_hd_exec raised ValueError unless variant == rt.
implemented_change.after: All five author variant names are accepted. Each variant computes the directed input1-to-input2 HDResult through the selected generic RTDL route and records variant_support metadata.

value_surface_contract.non_rt_variant_meaning: The author-style flag is accepted and RTDL returns a directed HDResult, but the author's variant-specific algorithm, timing denominator, and performance behavior are not reproduced.
value_surface_contract.route_selection: unchanged; --rtdl-route still selects the actual RTDL route

functional_parity_effect.improves: author-style hd_exec variant option acceptance for value output
